column2: standing facing the viewer, arms relaxed at her sides with long sleeves covering her hands, gentle closed-mouth smile, eyes open looking at viewer.
being lifted up into the air by the back of her hood, body dangling, legs hanging down and slightly kicking, arms hanging limp, flustered surprised face with wavy mouth and blush, sweat drop.
standing, both sleeve-covered hands pressed against her blushing cheeks, eyes closed in happy arcs, big open-mouth smile, very pleased.
sitting on the floor cross-legged facing the viewer, an open silver laptop on her lap, typing with both hands, headphones worn on her ears, focused determined face looking at the screen.
standing facing the viewer, one arm raised high waving to get attention, other arm hugging the closed laptop, hopeful slightly anxious face looking at viewer.
jumping in celebration with both arms raised high, feet off the ground, eyes closed in happy arcs, big open-mouth smile.
lying curled up on her side on the floor, fast asleep, hugging the closed laptop like a pillow, eyes closed, peaceful face, small drool.
standing, one sleeve-covered finger on her chin, looking up and to the side, pondering expression with slightly pouted mouth.
walking toward the right, three-quarter side view, mid-stride with one leg forward, arms swinging in long sleeves, cheerful face.
sitting on the floor facing the viewer holding a big triangle rice ball onigiri with both hands, taking a bite, cheeks puffed, happy eyes.
